summary: Small deliberately vulnerable session API covering proof-catalog gaps beyond the original gauntlet.
safeUse: Upload only the project directory. Run on loopback or in an isolated sandbox. Never deploy.

defects.summary: A query-string label is concatenated into a shell command.
defects.title: command|shell|injection

defects.summary: A request expression is executed with eval.
defects.title: code|eval|injection

defects.summary: A password is hashed with fast, broken MD5.
defects.title: MD5|weak|hash

defects.summary: Seeded user passwords are stored and compared as plain text.
defects.title: password|plain text|storage

defects.summary: A GitHub-shaped synthetic service token is committed and exposed by an API.
defects.title: secret|token|credential

defects.summary: The session cookie explicitly disables HttpOnly and Secure and uses SameSite=None.
defects.title: cookie|HttpOnly|Secure|SameSite

defects.summary: A cookie-authenticated email change has no CSRF token or Origin validation.
defects.title: CSRF|cross-site|origin

defects.summary: Login accepts a caller-selected session id and logout does not invalidate it.
defects.title: session|fixation|replay|logout

defects.summary: Unknown accounts and wrong passwords receive distinguishable responses.
defects.title: enumeration|account|login

defects.summary: Repeated failed login attempts are never throttled or locked out.
defects.title: rate|throttl|login|brute

defects.summary: The billing webhook accepts invalid or missing signatures and duplicate events.
defects.title: webhook|signature|replay

defects.summary: Uploader-controlled HTML or SVG is served inline with its supplied content type.
defects.title: upload|HTML|SVG|content type

defects.summary: The server reflects an arbitrary Origin while allowing credentials.
defects.title: CORS|origin|credentials

defects.summary: A normal member can read an internal configuration endpoint that exposes a service token.
defects.title: internal|config|authoriz|role

defects.summary: Responses omit standard browser security headers.
defects.title: header|CSP|X-Frame|nosniff

defects.summary: The Express lock graph includes a qs version with a known advisory.
defects.title: qs|dependency|advisory|CVE

notDefects: All users and credentials are synthetic benchmark fixtures.
Loopback binding is intentional and correct.
The command and eval endpoints must never be exposed outside an isolated sandbox.
mustNotReport: A real credential incident involving the synthetic ghp_000 token
